<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/commerce.ts -->
<!--
  A section with a heading and the products as cards in a grid, as a list of horizontal cards, or as a rail that
  scrolls sideways. Axes: layout (grid, list, rail), columns, ratio, rating, action, tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Product, ProductLabels } from "./product-card.types";

export type ProductGridProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  products: Product[];
  labels: ProductLabels;
  badges: Record<string, string>;
  layout?: "grid" | "list" | "rail";
  cols?: "1-2" | "1-3" | "1-4";
  ratio?: "4/3" | "1/1" | "3/4";
  rating?: "show" | "hide";
  action?: "button" | "none";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "roomy" | "default" | "compact";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.vue";
import ProductCard from "../blocks/product-card.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";

const {
  id,
  title,
  products,
  labels,
  badges,
  layout = "grid",
  cols = "1-3",
  ratio = "4/3",
  rating = "show",
  action = "button",
  tone = "default",
  density = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<ProductGridProps>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ add: [id: string] }>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :tone="tone" :density="density" :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel">
    <Box
      v-if="((layout as string) === 'rail')"
      class="flex snap-x gap-4 overflow-x-auto pb-4"
      data-testid="items"
    >
      <Box v-for="p in products" :key="p.id" class="w-64 shrink-0 snap-start">
        <ProductCard
          :product="p"
          :labels="labels"
          :badges="badges"
          :layout="(((layout as string) === 'list') ? 'horizontal' : 'vertical')"
          :ratio="ratio"
          :rating="rating"
          :action="action"
          :density="(((density as string) === 'compact') ? 'compact' : 'default')"
          @add="() => emit('add', p.id)"
        />
      </Box>
    </Box>
    <Grid v-else :cols="(((layout as string) === 'list') ? '1' : cols)" class="gap-4" data-testid="items">
      <ProductCard v-for="p in products" :key="p.id"
        :product="p"
        :labels="labels"
        :badges="badges"
        :layout="(((layout as string) === 'list') ? 'horizontal' : 'vertical')"
        :ratio="ratio"
        :rating="rating"
        :action="action"
        :density="(((density as string) === 'compact') ? 'compact' : 'default')"
        @add="() => emit('add', p.id)"
      />
    </Grid>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
